The team sniffs out myths to see if they are true or not! Watch as they test whether banana peels can create a slip and slide, and whether car engines can cook food like an oven and more!
#Discovery #MythBusters

About MythBusters:
Two special effects experts with over 30 years of experience set out to methodically bust three urban legends in each episode. They test theories to prove or disprove what is real and what is truly urban myth.
